map.升阻比越大越好吗？: Is a larger lift-to-drag ratio always better?
map.对航程/滑翔越好，但不是唯一目标。追求极大 L/D 常需高展弦比，牺牲速度与机动: Better for range and gliding, but not the only goal. Chasing an extreme L/D often needs high aspect ratio, sacrificing speed and maneuverability; fighters instead accept lower L/D for high speed. Trade off by mission.
map.最大升阻比对应什么速度？: What speed corresponds to maximum lift-to-drag ratio?
map.对应阻力最小时的速度（阻力极曲线最低点），也是燃油里程最佳点。偏离（更快或更慢）: The speed at which drag is minimal (the lowest point of the drag polar), also the best fuel mileage point. Deviating either way (faster or slower) reduces L/D and shortens range.
